news.text: ONLY ONE WILL REMAINLucio-Max showdown#Spalletti is not at risk: #Pioli is in the front line, DeLa's club is also at -11 from the top: the moment of truth on Sunday.#Juve, retreat and trial#Napoli, the keys handed to KDBCEO #Carnevali calls the squad to order. Wall around the coach: final warning. #Allegri still suspended, he hasn't beaten the bianconeri in fourteen years. #Lobotka out for 45 days. Kevin as a regista.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

LUCIO ON TRIAL?NO THE TEAM IS#Carnevali scolds the players: training retreat at least until the #Napoli match.According to #Juve, the primary person to blame is not #Spalletti.The intention is to move forward with the coach until the end of the season, even though many names of potential replacements are circulating if the situation were to deteriorate. Emblematic: only a single foul committed in Genoa during the entire 1st half! The CEO speaks of shame.[Front Page TuttoSport]

📊 #Juventus is going into a training retreat before the match on Sunday, November 1st against #Napoli, but the precedents are not particularly positive:▪️ At the beginning of March 2025, #ThiagoMotta sent the team into a training retreat before the match against #Verona: #Juve won 2-0, but after two very heavy defeats against #Atalanta and #Fiorentina, he was sacked a few weeks later.▫️ Igor #Tudor put the team into a retreat as soon as he arrived at la Continassa: he beat #Genoa 1-0 and then a good run followed, with four wins, a loss and three draws in the final eight matches of that season.▪️ #Tudor's cycle didn't even last a year: in October 2025 he said goodbye to the team and was repla

Since inaccurate information is still circulating on the subject… #ThiagoMotta is no longer under contract with #Juventus. The bianconero club made use of a clause - through the payment of a penalty - to terminate the contract as of June 30, 2026, prior to the automatic renewal to June 30, 2027. There is no mention of this in the financial balance sheet approved as of June 30, 2026, because all costs had already been charged to the financial year that concluded on June 30, 2025 (information obtained exclusively by Radio Bianconera/Bianconeranews via Antonio Paolino).[Mirko Nicolino]

❌❗️"Personally, I believe that the option of a return for #Conte is extremely difficult to materialize today. I do not think he is considering this possibility, not even remotely, especially in light of #Juventus's current situation."[Antonio Corsa - IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]

🕵🏻‍♂⚠️ #Juventus continues to work on strengthening the scouting sector, but #RealMadrid has also swooped in for #Fratini, with whom Juve has already had contact. The Blancos are looking for a key point of reference for the Italian mercato, tasked with identifying the best young talents to integrate in the Madrid youth academy.[Mirko Di Natale - TuttoJuve via @juventusinsidernews]

🧐❗️#Comolli was only the tip of the iceberg: the responsibilities for this negative period involve everyone: #Spalletti, #Carnevali and the entire management, including #Chiellini, cannot feel safe. They do not want to repeat the same script, but the failure to qualify made it necessary to identify a responsible party. The objective now is fourth place, but the competition is fierce.[Andrea Losapio - TuttoJuve via @juventusinsidernews]

👀🆕 #Spalletti is evaluating a revolution in the starting lineup ahead of the #Napoli match to react to the heavy defeat against #Genoa. In defense, #Kelly could return from the 1st minute replacing #Lucumí, while #Kalulu is challenging #Gatti. In attack, meanwhile, #Woltemade is raring to go for a starting shirt and could take the place of #KoloMuani.[Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🧐⁉️ "#Spalletti is playing for his future before the international break, at which point #Juventus will draw a line and, if things do not click into gear, he will be sacked. The club lets it be known that he is on the defensive, but the players must also take responsibility. A reaction in character is expected: losing can happen, but there is a right way and a wrong way to do it. Everyone is under scrutiny. The three matches will decide the coach's future, but keep an eye on the players as well, who could end up on the mercato. Mistakes are forbidden."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👊‼️ "#Carnevali has decided to use an iron fist. He held a meeting with the team, lecturing the players, criticizing them and confronting them with their own responsibilities. #Juventus will go into a punitive training retreat: the players will spend 48 hours locked inside the Continassa bunker to bond, try to resolve their problems, conduct an analysis, and engage in self-reflection to start afresh as early as Sunday."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 "Situation of the names linked to the #Juventus bench in the event that #Spalletti leaves the club:▫️Antonio #Conte: Although he is a big name who is well-liked, he is not currently convinced about taking over a team mid-season as a replacement manager; he would prefer a project from scratch in the summer (similar to what he did with #Napoli), unless an option abroad like #ManchesterUnited calls him, as it would take less time to rebuild.▪️​Stefano #Pioli: He emerges as the main and most viable candidate for the management in the event #Spalletti is dismissed.#Pioli would look favorably upon a 7-month contract with an option and has an excellent relationship with the technical area directo

Harsh scolding from the Ceo Giovanni #Carnevali to the players: now the #Juventus management will opt for the hard line. The team will go into a training retreat until Sunday evening, when the match against #Napoli will take place. Mistakes are forbidden and everyone is under scrutiny…[Nico Schira]

‼️If a managerial change were to happen between #Juventus and Luciano #Spalletti, the names on which I currently have confirmation are:🇫🇷 Didier #Deschamps🇮🇹 Stefano #Pioli🇵🇹 Paulo #Sousa[Mirko Di Natale]
‼️Morning training session for #Juventus. Discussion between #Carnevali and the team: the bianconeri will go into a training retreat starting tomorrow. (@demichelis90)[Mirko Di Natale]

As revealed yesterday Antonio #Conte is currently in Sharm el-Sheikh. He is getting several calls from insiders, but he seems oriented to wait next season to accept a SerieA’s Club. It’s a different matter for an english club (ManUnited) where it would take less time to rebuild…[Nico Schira]

👀 "#Juventus suffered a categorical 2-0 defeat against #Genoa at the Marassi stadium. With this setback, the team marks exactly one year under the management of Luciano #Spalletti wrapped in a slump of results and an absolute lack of identity and style of play.After the match, #Spalletti apologized to the fans.Although the #Juve management maintains a vote of confidence for the moment, it is limited and conditional.The coach will play for his continuity in the next three key matches before the November international break: the direct clash against #Napoli (both with 14 points after 9 matchdays), the Europa League match against #AZAlkmaar and the visit to #Fiorentina at the Artemio Franchi.If

👨‍🦲😩 Yesterday's defeat has increased the management's concern. Internal discussions are underway at la Continassa to analyze a complicated season, which has also been marked by injuries and mercato choices. #Elkann continues to confirm his trust in #Spalletti, the club wants to protect him and continue the project, but demands immediate answers. Without a convincing turning point, that support could waver.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🧐❗️The defeat in Genoa reopens reflections on #Spalletti's future. In the coming hours, the ownership must send a signal: #Elkann is bound by a relationship with the coach built on mutual esteem, but trust must be fueled by results. On Sunday, there is #Napoli, a clash that could represent a true final test with no right of appeal.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
